title: •Red 5
caption: •Red 5 (V)
game_text: May add Luke as pilot and {set:anh} R2-D2 (may ▼ here.) During battle, may cancel a starfighter’s game text here (except related to capacity, ability, and identity of permanent pilot). Immune to attrition < 6.
lore: Luke’s Incom T-65 X-wing at the Battle of Yavin. Instrumentation similarities between Red 5 and the T-16 skyhopper allowed Luke to play a pivotal role in the conflict.
